parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift', a test file in the Artwork package. Although the pipeline has flagged is_test=false on each record (likely a classification gap caused by the enclosing type names — iTunesArtworkServiceTests, LastFMArtworkServiceTests, DiscogsArtworkServiceTests — not being picked up as test classes), the file path unambiguously places every member inside the Tests/ target. The SequentialMockSession.data methods are mock/stub helpers nested inside per-service test classes; consolidating them would couple test-internal mock infrastructure across otherwise independent test suites. No production code is involved, so no production benefit accrues from extraction.
